<!doctype html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#15191a">
<meta name="description" content="Visite privée immersive 360° d’un appartement Airbnb à Neuilly-Plaisance, assemblée dans l’identité OVISION 360 avec panoramas améliorés.">
<title>Appartement Airbnb à Neuilly-Plaisance | Visite privée OVISION 360</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--paper:#f6f8f8;--muted:#c2c9c9;--glow:rgba(255,255,255,.16);--stroke:rgba(255,255,255,.25);--glass:rgba(17,23,27,.48);--shadow:0 12px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.24);--whiteglass:rgba(245,248,250,.90)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#111515;color:#fff;font-family:Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;overscroll-behavior:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #9fd5ff;outline-offset:3px}button:disabled{opacity:.40;cursor:wait}svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex:none;display:block}
#tour{position:relative;width:100%;height:100dvh;min-height:340px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background:#282929}
#viewer{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;display:block;width:100%;height:100%;cursor:grab;touch-action:none}#viewer.dragging{cursor:grabbing}
#still{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#353736 center center/cover no-repeat;z-index:-1}
#shade{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,12,13,.35) 0%,transparent 17%,transparent 60%,rgba(5,10,12,.48) 100%);z-index:1}
#hotspots{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:3;pointer-events:none}#hotspots.no-interaction{opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s ease}
.hotspot{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:0;background:none;padding:12px 14px;color:white;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:11px;pointer-events:auto;white-space:nowrap;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.45));transition:opacity .15s}
.hotspot[hidden]{display:none!important}.hotspot-core{height:52px;width:52px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.96);background:rgba(255,255,255,.17);backdrop-filter:blur(9px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px);box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(255,255,255,.15),0 0 27px rgba(255,255,255,.18);transition:transform .2s,background .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.hotspot-core svg{width:23px;height:23px}.hotspot:hover .hotspot-core{transform:scale(1.1);background:rgba(255,255,255,.31);box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(255,255,255,.13),0 0 33px rgba(255,255,255,.24)}
.hotspot-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.23);border-radius:99px;background:rgba(15,22,26,.67);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.header{position:absolute;z-index:6;left:clamp(15px,3vw,38px);right:clamp(15px,3vw,38px);top:clamp(15px,3vw,30px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;pointer-events:none}
.head-main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;pointer-events:auto;min-width:0}
.brand{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78);background:var(--whiteglass);color:#15202a;padding:12px 15px;border-radius:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(18px)}
.brand-word{font-weight:820;font-size:18px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-1.3px}.brand-word small{font-size:9px;vertical-align:top;letter-spacing:-.2px;margin-left:3px;color:#398ac0}.brand-line{width:1px;height:26px;background:#c4d0d6}.brand-sub{font-size:9px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:1px;color:#5b6770;font-weight:750}
.top-address{font-size:12px;font-weight:550;letter-spacing:.01em;color:white;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #172125;padding:12px 3px;white-space:nowrap}
.head-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;pointer-events:auto}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;height:43px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:14px;padding:0 15px;background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(19px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(19px);color:white;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .2s,transform .2s}
.pill:hover,.circle:hover{background:rgba(52,62,67,.78);transform:translateY(-1px)}.pill svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.pill.active{background:rgba(245,249,250,.9);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);color:#18252c}
.circle{height:44px;width:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;border-radius:14px;background:var(--glass);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);color:#fff;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .2s,transform .2s}.circle svg{width:19px;height:19px}
.side-controls{position:absolute;right:clamp(15px,3vw,38px);top:50%;transform:translateY(-45%);z-index:5;display:grid;gap:8px}.side-gap{height:8px}
.footer{position:absolute;z-index:5;bottom:clamp(14px,3vw,30px);left:clamp(15px,3vw,38px);right:clamp(15px,3vw,38px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:24px;pointer-events:none}.footer>*{pointer-events:auto}
.scene-info{min-width:280px;max-width:390px;flex:0 1 350px;background:var(--whiteglass);color:#15212a;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.65);border-radius:20px;padding:19px 23px 20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(24px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px)}.info-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}.scene-kicker{font-size:9px;font-weight:760;color:#5083a0;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase}.scene-count{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;font-weight:700;color:#7b8a93}
.scene-info h1{font-size:clamp(23px,2.7vw,32px);line-height:1.2;font-weight:690;letter-spacing:-1.25px;margin:10px 0 7px}.scene-info p{margin:0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55;color:#65747d}.info-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px solid #d9dedf}.info-foot small{font-size:10px;color:#7b858c;font-weight:600}.info-foot button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:0;color:#345c72;background:transparent;padding:4px 0;font-size:10px;font-weight:760}.info-foot svg{width:13px;height:13px}
.scenes-strip{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:7px;padding:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.42);border-radius:19px;background:rgba(248,249,249,.85);box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px);max-width:min(770px,65vw)}
.scene-chip{width:124px;min-width:0;flex:none;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;background:transparent;padding:5px;text-align:left;color:#4b5960;display:grid;gap:7px;transition:transform .17s,background .17s}.scene-chip:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.65)}.scene-chip.current{background:#1d282e;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.17)}.scene-chip img{width:100%;height:68px;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:8px;background:#444}.scene-chip.current img{opacity:.94}.scene-chip-txt{font-size:10px;font-weight:750;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;padding:0 3px 4px}.scene-chip-num{font-size:9px;opacity:.5;display:inline-block;margin-right:7px;letter-spacing:.04em}
#intro{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,17,21,.75),rgba(11,18,20,.43) 38%,rgba(13,19,21,.05) 100%);display:flex;align-items:center;transition:opacity .38s,visibility .38s;padding:clamp(25px,5.6vw,100px)}#intro.closed{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}.intro-inner{max-width:680px;padding-bottom:30px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 18px #0005)}.intro-eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2.5px;font-weight:760;text-transform:uppercase}.intro-eyebrow:before{content:"";display:block;height:1px;width:41px;background:#e0e9ec}.intro-inner h2{font-size:clamp(47px,6.7vw,91px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.07em;font-weight:610;margin:24px 0 21px}.intro-inner h2 em{font-style:normal;color:#e1e9eb}.intro-inner p{font-size:clamp(14px,1.6vw,17px);line-height:1.65;color:#e0e3e3;max-width:460px;margin:0 0 29px}.intro-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.start{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:15px;padding:16px 20px;border-radius:14px;background:#f4f8f9;color:#15222c;border:1px solid #fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:780;box-shadow:0 14px 42px #0003}.start svg{width:18px;height:18px}.start:hover{background:#fff;transform:translateY(-1px)}.start-sub{font-size:11px;color:#d7dfdf;letter-spacing:.03em}
#toast{position:absolute;z-index:12;top:101px;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-12px);padding:11px 17px;border-radius:100px;background:rgba(22,27,29,.77);border:1px solid #fff3;color:white;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;white-space:nowrap}#toast.shown{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
#help{position:absolute;right:clamp(15px,3vw,38px);top:91px;z-index:8;width:min(330px,calc(100vw - 30px));padding:21px 21px 18px;border-radius:19px;background:rgba(248,249,249,.95);border:1px solid #fff;color:#17242d;box-shadow:var(--shadow);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);display:none}#help.visible{display:block}#help h3{margin:0 0 11px;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.45px}#help p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.58;color:#66747b;margin:0 0 11px}#help .note{font-size:10px;color:#7a868c;line-height:1.6;border-top:1px solid #d6dcde;padding-top:12px;margin-top:13px}#help .switch-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;margin-top:14px}#help .switch-row span{font-size:11px;font-weight:700}#sourceBtn{border:1px solid #d7dfe2;background:white;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;color:#233b48;font-size:10px;font-weight:700}
.progress{position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:3px;z-index:9;pointer-events:none;background:transparent}.progress div{width:0;height:100%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);transition:width .06s linear}
#notsupported{display:none;position:absolute;z-index:17;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:min(480px,90vw);padding:25px;background:#f7f8f9;color:#26343a;border-radius:18px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
@media(max-width:1150px){.top-address{display:none}.scenes-strip{max-width:55vw;overflow-x:auto}.scene-chip{width:106px}.scene-chip img{height:58px}.scene-info{max-width:315px;padding:16px 18px}.side-controls{top:46%}}
@media(max-width:730px){.header{top:13px;left:13px;right:13px}.brand{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:13px}.brand-word{font-size:16px}.brand-sub{font-size:8px}.head-actions .pill{padding:0 11px;height:40px}.head-actions .pill span{display:none}.circle{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:13px}.side-controls{right:13px;top:49%;gap:7px}.side-controls .circle{width:39px;height:39px}.footer{bottom:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:12px;right:12px;display:block}.scene-info{max-width:none;width:100%;min-width:0;padding:12px 16px 13px;border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:8px}.scene-info h1{font-size:23px;margin:6px 0 4px}.scene-info p{display:none}.info-foot{display:none}.scenes-strip{width:100%;max-width:none;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;gap:5px;padding:5px;border-radius:14px}.scenes-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}.scene-chip{width:100px;padding:3px;gap:5px;border-radius:9px}.scene-chip img{height:50px;border-radius:6px}.scene-chip-txt{font-size:9px;padding-bottom:3px}.scene-chip-num{display:none}#intro{padding:25px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b121cbe,#07131966)}.intro-inner{padding-bottom:30px}.intro-inner h2{font-size:clamp(46px,11vw,68px)}.intro-inner p{font-size:13px}.start-sub{display:none}.hotspot-label{font-size:10px}.hotspot-core{height:43px;width:43px}#help{top:67px;right:12px}#toast{top:75px}}
@media(max-height:540px){.scene-info{display:none}.scene-chip img{height:42px}.scenes-strip{max-height:78px}.header{top:8px}.side-controls{gap:4px}.side-controls .circle{width:35px;height:35px}.intro-inner h2{font-size:clamp(36px,5vw,56px);margin:12px 0}.intro-inner p{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:12px}.start{padding:10px 15px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{transition-duration:.01ms!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important}}
</style>

<style id="ovision-deepsea-premium">
:root{--champagne:#dac3a0;--champagne-light:#f1e3c8;--ink:#101113;--panel:rgba(17,19,20,.50);--panelstroke:rgba(255,255,255,.24);--soft:#eaeced;--hint:rgba(255,255,255,.67);color-scheme:dark}
html,body,#tour{font-family:Inter, -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Avenir Next', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial,sans-serif;background:#0f1012}
#shade{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,7,9,.38) 0%,rgba(4,7,9,.07) 17%,transparent 28%,transparent 72%,rgba(2,5,6,.22) 88%,rgba(3,6,7,.55) 100%)}

.brand:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;width:18px;height:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(-28deg);border:2px solid var(--champagne);border-right-color:rgba(218,195,160,.24);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(212,185,145,.10)}
.brand-word{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.045em;font-weight:760}.brand-word small{font-size:10px;vertical-align:baseline;font-weight:590;color:var(--champagne);margin-left:4px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand-line{background:rgba(255,255,255,.33);height:24px}.brand-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.80);letter-spacing:.18em;font-size:8px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.6}
.top-address{color:rgba(255,255,255,.66);font-size:11px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.04em;padding:9px;text-shadow:0 1px 12px #0005}

.circle,.pill{background:rgba(12,14,16,.30);color:white;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);box-shadow:0 10px 35px #0002, inset 0 1px 0 #fff1;backdrop-filter:blur(20px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-radius:100px;height:36px;transition:background .22s,transform .24s,border-color .22s}
.circle{width:36px}.circle svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke-width:1.45}.pill{padding:0 13px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.02em;font-weight:570}.pill svg{width:15px;height:15px}
.pill:hover,.circle:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);transform:translateY(-1px)}.pill.active{background:rgba(219,193,153,.85);color:#1c1c1c;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.42)}
.side-controls{right:clamp(22px,3vw,48px);gap:6px;top:50%}.side-controls .circle{width:34px;height:34px}.side-controls .side-gap{height:3px}
.footer{left:clamp(22px,3vw,48px);right:clamp(22px,3vw,48px);bottom:clamp(20px,2.3vw,35px);align-items:flex-end;gap:14px}
.scene-info{background:rgba(11,13,16,.43);box-shadow:0 12px 35px #0002;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:16px;color:white;min-width:210px;max-width:270px;flex:0 0 auto;padding:15px 19px 13px;backdrop-filter:blur(24px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(24px)}
.scene-kicker{font-size:8px;font-weight:580;letter-spacing:.17em;color:var(--champagne);text-transform:uppercase}.scene-count{color:rgba(255,255,255,.61);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:550;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.scene-info h1{font-size:25px;font-weight:520;letter-spacing:-.042em;margin:6px 0 5px;line-height:1.12}.scene-info p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.70);font-size:10px;line-height:1.55;letter-spacing:.005em;max-width:230px}
.info-foot{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px}.info-foot small{color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);font-size:9px;font-weight:400}.info-foot button{color:var(--champagne-light);font-size:9px;font-weight:570;letter-spacing:.04em}
.scenes-strip{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);padding:6px;gap:4px;border-radius:15px;background:rgba(9,11,12,.46);box-shadow:0 12px 38px #0003;max-width:min(700px,70vw);backdrop-filter:blur(26px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(26px)}
.scene-chip{border:1px solid transparent;background:transparent;border-radius:11px;width:104px;padding:4px;gap:5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.70);transition:background .2s ease,opacity .2s ease;opacity:.80}
.scene-chip:hover{opacity:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}.scene-chip.current{opacity:1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-color:rgba(218,195,160,.78);color:white}
.scene-chip img{height:54px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;filter:saturate(.96)}.scene-chip.current img{opacity:1}
.scene-chip-txt{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.01em;padding:1px 2px 3px}.scene-chip-num{font-size:8px;opacity:.53;margin-right:6px}
.hotspot{gap:7px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 10px #0005)}.hotspot-core{width:37px;height:37px;border:1px solid rgba(245,241,232,.78);background:rgba(15,16,18,.30);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(245,241,232,.12),0 0 25px #0003;transition:transform .25s,background .25s,box-shadow .25s}.hotspot-core svg{width:17px;height:17px;stroke-width:1.55;color:#fff}.hotspot-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.025em;font-weight:510;padding:6px 10px;background:rgba(13,16,17,.44);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.17);border-radius:100px;backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}.hotspot:hover .hotspot-core{transform:scale(1.1);background:rgba(216,191,156,.45);box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(245,241,232,.11),0 0 18px #0003}
#intro{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,11,13,.78) 0%,rgba(10,11,13,.57) 32%,rgba(10,11,13,.12) 76%,rgba(10,11,13,.05) 100%);padding:clamp(28px,6vw,110px)}
.intro-inner{max-width:680px;padding-bottom:0}.intro-eyebrow{font-size:10px;font-weight:520;letter-spacing:.27em;color:var(--champagne-light)}.intro-eyebrow:before{background:var(--champagne);width:28px}
.intro-inner h2{font-size:clamp(50px,7.8vw,98px);font-weight:480;letter-spacing:-.077em;line-height:1.02;margin:20px 0 19px}.intro-inner h2 em{color:var(--champagne-light)}.intro-inner p{font-size:clamp(13px,1.22vw,16px);color:rgba(255,255,255,.77);line-height:1.7;font-weight:370;max-width:490px;margin-bottom:24px}
.start{border-radius:99px;padding:13px 22px 13px 25px;background:var(--champagne-light);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);font-size:11px;font-weight:630;letter-spacing:.03em;color:#222324;box-shadow:0 10px 25px #0003;gap:16px;transition:transform .24s,background .2s}.start:hover{background:#fff4df;transform:translateY(-2px)}.start svg{width:17px;height:17px}.start-sub{color:rgba(255,255,255,.63);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.04em}
#help{background:rgba(23,26,27,.87);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.20);box-shadow:0 18px 50px #0005;backdrop-filter:blur(32px)}#help h3{color:#fff;font-weight:570}#help p,#help .note{color:rgba(255,255,255,.75)}#help .note{border-top-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}#sourceBtn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:white;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.progress div{background:var(--champagne)}
#toast{background:rgba(18,20,22,.85);color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
@media(max-width:1150px){.scenes-strip{max-width:60vw}.scene-info{max-width:220px;min-width:200px}.scene-chip{width:98px}.scene-chip img{height:50px}}
@media(max-width:730px){.header{top:max(15px,env(safe-area-inset-top));left:16px;right:16px}.brand{padding-left:25px}.brand-word{font-size:16px}.brand-sub{display:none}.brand-line{display:none}.head-actions{gap:5px}.head-actions .pill{height:34px;padding:0 10px}.circle{width:34px;height:34px}.side-controls{right:14px;top:50%;gap:5px}.side-controls .circle{width:31px;height:31px}.footer{left:12px;right:12px;bottom:max(14px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.scene-info{width:100%;min-width:0;max-width:none;padding:9px 13px 9px;border-radius:13px;margin-bottom:7px}.scene-info h1{font-size:19px;margin:3px 0}.scene-info p{display:none}.info-foot{display:none}.scenes-strip{width:100%;max-width:100%;padding:4px;gap:3px;border-radius:12px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}.scene-chip{width:96px;min-width:96px;padding:3px}.scene-chip img{height:47px}.scene-chip-txt{font-size:9px}.scene-chip-num{display:none}#intro{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(6,8,10,.77),rgba(8,10,11,.37));padding:28px}.intro-inner h2{font-size:clamp(50px,11vw,70px);letter-spacing:-.07em}.intro-inner p{font-size:13px}.hotspot-label{font-size:9px}.hotspot-core{height:35px;width:35px}#help{top:64px;right:12px}}
@media(max-height:550px){.scene-info{display:none}.scene-chip img{height:40px}.scenes-strip{max-height:73px}.intro-inner h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5.2vw,60px)}.intro-inner p{max-width:440px;line-height:1.4}.footer{bottom:12px}}
#tour:has(#intro:not(.closed)) .footer,#tour:has(#intro:not(.closed)) .side-controls,#tour:has(#intro:not(.closed)) .head-actions,#tour:has(#intro:not(.closed)) .top-address,#tour:has(#intro:not(.closed)) #hotspots{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}#tour:has(#intro:not(.closed)) .header{z-index:12}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="tour" role="application" aria-label="Visite virtuelle privée 360° de l’appartement">
  <div id="still"></div><canvas id="viewer" aria-label="Vue panoramique immersive, faites glisser pour regarder autour de vous"></canvas><div id="shade"></div><div id="hotspots"></div>
  <header class="header">
    <div class="head-main"><div class="brand"><div class="brand-word">OVISION<small>360</small></div><div class="brand-line"></div><div class="brand-sub">VISITE<br>PRIVÉE</div></div><div class="top-address">Appartement <span style="opacity:.55;padding:0 6px">/</span> Neuilly-Plaisance</div></div>
    <div class="head-actions">
      <button class="pill" id="autoplayBtn" type="button" aria-label="Lancer le parcours guidé"><svg id="playIcon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m8 5 11 7-11 7z"/></svg><span id="autoplayText">Parcours guidé</span></button>
      <button class="circle" id="helpBtn" type="button" aria-label="Informations et version des panoramas" title="Informations"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v5M12 7.5v.5"/></svg></button>
      <button class="circle" id="fullBtn" type="button" aria-label="Passer en plein écran" title="Plein écran"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 3H3v5m13-5h5v5M3 16v5h5m13-5v5h-5"/></svg></button>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="side-controls"><button type="button" class="circle" id="zoomIn" aria-label="Zoomer" title="Zoomer"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M16.5 16.5 21 21M8 11h6m-3-3v6"/></svg></button><button type="button" class="circle" id="zoomOut" aria-label="Dézoomer" title="Dézoomer"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M16.5 16.5 21 21M8 11h6"/></svg></button><div class="side-gap"></div><button type="button" class="circle" id="resetBtn" aria-label="Recentrer la vue" title="Recentrer"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/><path d="M12 4v3m0 10v3M4 12h3m10 0h3"/></svg></button></div>
  <div class="footer"><section class="scene-info" aria-live="polite"><div class="info-top"><div class="scene-kicker" id="category">ESPACE DE VIE</div><div class="scene-count" id="sceneNumber">01 / 05</div></div><h1 id="sceneTitle">Le séjour</h1><p id="description">Salon lumineux et ouverture sur la terrasse</p><div class="info-foot"><small>360° · Explorer à son rythme</small><button id="nextBtn" type="button">Pièce suivante <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button></div></section><nav id="sceneStrip" class="scenes-strip" aria-label="Choisir une pièce"></nav></div>
  <section id="intro"><div class="intro-inner"><div class="intro-eyebrow">OVISION 360 <span style="opacity:.5;margin:0 2px">/</span> COLLECTION PRIVÉE</div><h2>Bienvenue.<br><em>Entrez.</em><br>Explorez.</h2><p>Découvrez cet appartement Airbnb à Neuilly-Plaisance dans une visite privée fluide, lumineuse et immersive, pensée dans l’esprit OVISION 360.</p><div class="intro-actions"><button class="start" id="startBtn" type="button">Commencer la visite <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/></svg></button><span class="start-sub">5 panoramas · Transitions fluides</span></div></div></section>
  <div id="toast" role="status"></div>
  <aside id="help"><h3>Explorer en toute liberté</h3><p>Déplacez votre souris ou votre doigt pour regarder autour de vous. Utilisez les points lumineux pour passer d’une pièce à l’autre. Molette ou boutons pour zoomer.</p><p>Le parcours guidé enchaîne automatiquement les cinq vues avec des transitions très rapides et plus fluides.</p><div class="switch-row"><span id="sourceLabel">Panoramas améliorés</span><button id="sourceBtn" type="button">Voir les originaux</button></div><div class="note">Les images améliorées ont été retravaillées par IA et peuvent modifier certains détails. Les photos originales, non retouchées par IA, restent disponibles. Cette visite est privée dans le sens où elle n’est pas publiée sur Google Maps ; le fichier HTML n’est pas protégé par un mot de passe.</div></aside>
  <div class="progress"><div id="progressBar"></div></div><div id="notsupported">Impossible d’afficher la projection 360° sur ce navigateur. Ouvrez ce fichier dans une version récente de Chrome, Safari, Firefox ou Edge.</div>
</div>
